decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly assembling key pieces that enable a powerful combo involving Necrodominance and March of Wretched Sorrow, allowing for a massive amount of damage to be dealt to the opponent. The deck includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to protect the combo pieces, along with efficient mana acceleration through cards like Chrome Mox and Lotus Petal. The creatures in the deck, such as Dauthi Voidwalker and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, provide additional utility and threats to the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to win the game through a fast and devastating combo.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Knight of the Reliquary and Endurance to quickly pressure the opponent. The deck also includes tools like Mox Diamond and Crop Rotation to ramp up and search for key lands like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage for a powerful combo finish. Green Sun's Zenith and Elvish Reclaimer help to find the necessary pieces for the deck's strategy, while cards like Swords to Plowshares provide removal options. The deck's mana base is carefully constructed to support its aggressive game plan and combo potential.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful creatures to control the game and outvalue the opponent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also ramping up its own resources through cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Life from the Loam. The deck also includes a small land destruction package with cards like Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to play a long, grindy game and eventually overwhelm the opponent with its powerful threats and control elements.

The deck focuses on fast-paced aggression and disruption, utilizing low-cost spells and efficient creatures to control the tempo of the game. It combines card draw and selection with powerful threats like Murktide Regent and True-Name Nemesis to quickly apply pressure while countering opposing plays with cards like Force of Will and Daze. The mana base is streamlined to support the aggressive strategy, with a focus on maximizing early game plays and disrupting the opponent's mana base with cards like Wasteland.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap, efficient spells and creatures to maintain tempo and control of the board while quickly chipping away at the opponent's life total. By disrupting their opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Daze, while also providing threats with Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent, this deck aims to aggressively pressure the opponent and dictate the pace of the game. The deck is well-positioned to handle a variety of strategies with its mix of disruption, card selection, removal, and threats.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling a powerful combo that aims to win the game in a single turn. The deck features a mixture of efficient mana acceleration, disruption, and combo pieces that work together to achieve a game-winning play. With the right sequence of cards, the deck aims to mill the opponent's entire library, ensuring victory through the use of cards like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer. The deck is designed to be fast and aggressive, aiming to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to respond.

The deck focuses on quickly putting powerful creatures into play from the graveyard using cards like Reanimate and Entomb. It also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo. The deck includes a mix of threats like Brazen Borrower, Murktide Regent, and Archon of Cruelty to pressure the opponent while setting up the combo. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and includes utility lands like Wasteland. Additionally, the deck includes some planeswalkers like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student for card advantage and control.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, then bringing them back into play with Reanimate and Animate Dead. It also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo, as well as cards like Murktide Regent and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to apply pressure on the opponent. The key strategy is to efficiently reanimate threatening creatures while controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to control and disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Spell Pierce, the deck aims to protect its own threats while dealing with the opponent's threats efficiently. The inclusion of Snapcaster Mage allows for additional value by recasting important spells from the graveyard. Overall, the deck aims to out-value the opponent and grind out a win through incremental advantage and disruption.

The deck focuses on using lands as control elements and win conditions, with key cards like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a powerful 20/20 Marit Lage token. It also includes disruption elements like Mox Diamond and Boseiju, Who Endures to protect its land-based strategy. Life from the Loam provides card advantage and graveyard recursion, while cards like Crop Rotation and Wasteland help to disrupt the opponent's mana base. This deck aims to grind out the opponent with its land-based control elements and eventually win with its powerful land synergies.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, and then bringing them back onto the battlefield to overwhelm the opponent. It also utilizes counter spells like Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect its combo pieces. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Brazen Borrower while efficiently controlling the board with cards like Wasteland. Overall, the deck aims to win the game by executing its powerful reanimation combo while disrupting the opponent's plans.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, then bringing them back onto the battlefield with spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with countermagic like Force of Will and Daze while also applying pressure with efficient threats like Archon of Cruelty and Murktide Regent. The deck aims to win by overwhelming the opponent with big creatures that can quickly end the game if left unchecked, making it a versatile and dangerous combo deck in Legacy 1 vs 1 format.

The main concept of this deck is to use Show and Tell to put powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn onto the battlefield for free, thanks to Omniscience. Cunning Wish allows for additional spells to be accessed from the sideboard in response to opponent's plays. The deck also includes Atraxa, Grand Unifier to help control the board and protect the combo. The key strategy is to quickly ramp up mana with cards like Ancient Tomb and play the game-winning creatures before the opponent can react, locking in victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently combo off by using a combination of high-risk spells and creatures to mill through the deck and win the game with a powerful finisher. By utilizing cards like Balustrade Spy, Undercity Informer, and Dread Return, the deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard and win the game with cards like Thassa's Oracle or Pact of Negation. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy to protect the combo and ensure a smooth win condition.

The deck focuses on using creatures like Nadu, Winged Wisdom, Nomads en-Kor, and Springheart Nantuko to generate mana and quickly ramp into powerful creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth or Allosaurus Shepherd. It also relies on cards like Chord of Calling and Green Sun's Zenith to tutor for key combo pieces. The deck utilizes creatures with abilities to protect itself or disrupt opponents, while also having access to powerful lands like Gaea's Cradle for additional mana generation. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creature plays.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with efficient creatures and versatile spells. By combining disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Daze with aggressive threats like Barrowgoyf and Brazen Borrower, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and win through consistent damage. It utilizes a mix of removal, counterspells, and card advantage to maintain control of the battlefield and outmaneuver opponents. Additionally, the inclusion of graveyard hate like Nihil Spellbomb helps to disrupt opposing strategies reliant on the graveyard.
